name: Embedded Text Finder
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Inline code no longer hides text and embeds across a blank line.
Exports escape math and highlight markers.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
A stray backtick in one paragraph no longer hides text and embeds in the paragraphs after it.
Exported results show $, =, % and & as plain text, so they no longer turn into math or highlights.
tip: Open a note with many embeds and run Find text in the active note and its embeds to search only that note and what it embeds.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Embedded Text Finder is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to find things in your vault.
